Text:
Huh…
It sure is
huge, alright.
Gotta be
careful not to
fall.

But do be
careful not to
drop anything
from up here.

There’s a park
down there,
so if anything
here falls,
it might hit
someone.

… Huh?!
It’s not here…
It’s gone!
I could’ve
sworn it was
here…

Huh? Didn’t
you just
tell me to be
careful not to
drop anything?

No, not like
that.
I lost
something on
the way here.

If you want
it, then fight
me for it,
ugah!

But shouldn’t
you have left
something
that important
back at the
Theater?

Well, sure,
but…
This wallet is
very special
to me.
My father gave
it to me.

I feel safer
when I have it
with me, like
my father is
watching over
me…
